items.q: Frank Fairfax had the big band that he took over from Chappie Willett... Chappie Willett was the ace arranger at that point and got the band together

ctx.x: Yeah. But Frank Fairfax had the big band that he took over from Chappie Willett. [Rawfield, west] They were a black college band from Virginia that came to Philadelphia and Chappie Willett was the ace arranger at that point and got the band together, but there wasn't any work for a big band. There wasn't any work for seven day, six day basis for music in Philadelphia, period.
